name: OnOff
tagline: Twenty-five rooms. Flip the world. The file remembers the room.
description:
Close it on room 18, open it on room 18. The furthest room lives in this GIF — no account, no install, works offline.

A little robot, two layers of platforms, and a button that swaps which one is solid. Walk, jump, toggle. Spikes kill you. Reach the pulsing goal. Twenty-five hand-made rooms from the 2018 js13kGames jam.

On a phone: left, right, JUMP, and ON/OFF under your thumbs. On a computer it is WASD or the arrows, space to flip.

An unofficial port of OnOff by Daniel Marino and Brad Dunbar, MIT-licensed.
